say:5:1410522003:1.source_cn: 声音……我听到了一个声音。

choice_prompt:6:1410522003.source_cn: 声音……我听到了一个声音。

say:8:1410522004:1.text: A voice speaking in a language I don't know, but somehow I can understand it... and feel its anger.
say:8:1410522004:1.source_cn: 它说着我未曾听闻过的语言，但我却能够理解其中的含义……...
say:8:1410522004:1.male: A voice speaking in a language I don't know, but somehow I can understand it... and feel its anger.
say:8:1410522004:1.female: A voice speaking in a language I don't know, but somehow I can understand it... and feel its anger.

say:9:1410522005:1.text: Did I do something wrong? Why is it so angry...? I can hear it cursing.
say:9:1410522005:1.source_cn: 是我做错什么了吗？为什么会如此愤怒……我能听到它在诅咒——
say:9:1410522005:1.male: Did I do something wrong? Why is it so angry...? I can hear it cursing.
say:9:1410522005:1.female: Did I do something wrong? Why is it so angry...? I can hear it cursing.

say:11:1410522006:1.text:
Cursing? Oh, no...
<shk>Snap out of it!</shk> Don't listen to it!
say:11:1410522006:1.source_cn: 诅咒？你听到的该不会是……\n<shk>醒醒小子！</...

say:14:1410522008:1.text: Covering your ears won't help! You need to focus and push that voice out of your mind!
say:14:1410522008:1.source_cn: 不能光是捂着耳朵！你得集中精神，把那个声音从你脑袋里赶出去！

say:15:1410522009:1.text:
Ahhh, I'm trying!
Okay, okay... focus...!
say:15:1410522009:1.source_cn: 我知道了！\n集中……集中……集中！

narration:16:1410522010:0.text: Feli is concentrating on resisting that voice. You all stand by quietly and wait...
narration:16:1410522010:0.source_cn: 斐利尔正在集中精神对抗那个声音，你们静立一旁，屏息等待……

say:17:1410522011:1.text: Phew, I did it. Thank you, Zanie.
say:17:1410522011:1.source_cn: 呼……好多了……祖娅，谢谢你的提醒。

say:20:1410522013:1.text: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'd rather keep it to myself for now, just in case I'm off the mark.
say:20:1410522013:1.source_cn: 我也不确定……只是心里有个猜测。不确定的事情，我不想乱说。
say:20:1410522013:1.male: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'd rather keep it to myself for now, just in case I'm off the mark.
say:20:1410522013:1.female: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'd rather keep it to myself for now, just in case I'm off the mark.

say:21:1410522015:1.text: Let's keep looking for the lift. We can talk about it once we're safely back on the surface.
say:21:1410522015:1.source_cn: 继续寻找升降机吧，有什么话，等我们回到了安全的地面再说。
say:21:1410522015:1.male: Let's keep looking for the lift. We can talk about it once we're safely back on the surface.
say:21:1410522015:1.female: Let's keep looking for the lift. We can talk about it once we're safely back on the surface.

say:23:1410522014:1.text: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'll hold off until I'm 100% sure—I don't want you to accuse me of being overly dramatic.
say:23:1410522014:1.source_cn: 我大概能猜到那是谁的声音，等确定了再告诉你，省得你说我...
say:23:1410522014:1.male: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'll hold off until I'm 100% sure—I don't want you to accuse me of being overly dramatic.
say:23:1410522014:1.female: I think I know whose voice it is, but I'll hold off until I'm 100% sure—I don't want you to accuse me of being overly dramatic.

choice:19:1:2.text: How did you know what to do?
choice:19:1:2.male: How did you know what to do?
choice:19:1:2.female: How did you know what to do?

say:2:1410524001:1.text: Alright, Pointy Ears, this is where we part. Make sure you take the same route back.
say:2:1410524001:1.source_cn: 祭司小子，我们待会要直接离开了，你记得原路返回。

say:3:1410524002:1.text: Huh? Um... you're just letting me go like this?
say:3:1410524002:1.source_cn: 咦！你们要回去了？呃，我是说，你们就直接把我放走了？

choice_prompt:4:1410524002.text: Huh? Um... you're just letting me go like this?
choice_prompt:4:1410524002.source_cn: 咦！你们要回去了？呃，我是说，你们就直接把我放走了？

say:5:1410524003:1.text: How could I possibly travel with you evil intruders!
say:5:1410524003:1.source_cn: 你们可是邪恶的潜入者，我怎么可能和你们同行……

say:6:1410524005:1.text: Enough chit-chat; you should hurry back home. After all, it seems like your people can't even step foot on the surface.
say:6:1410524005:1.source_cn: 那就好，你快点回去吧，毕竟你们艾塞勒似乎是无法踏足地表的。

say:7:1410524006:1.text: Hmph, what's so good about the surface anyway? The underground is the real paradise!
say:7:1410524006:1.source_cn: 哼，毕竟地表上毫无可取之处，我们深居的地底才是真正的乐...

choice_prompt:8:1410524006.text: Hmph, what's so good about the surface anyway? The underground is the real paradise!
choice_prompt:8:1410524006.source_cn: 哼，毕竟地表上毫无可取之处，我们深居的地底才是真正的乐园……！

say:9:1410524007:1.text: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!
say:9:1410524007:1.source_cn: 唔……女王所说的就是事实。女王恩泽萨洛克兰，没理由骗我们！
say:9:1410524007:1.male: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!
say:9:1410524007:1.female: N-not really... but Her Majesty speaks only the truth, and there's no reason to doubt it!

say:10:1410524009:1.text: Oh, you're adorable. Listen, the cruelest tricks aren't played by your enemies. They're played by the ones you trust.
say:10:1410524009:1.source_cn: 你还真是个小孩子啊，天真！这世界的残酷真相之一就是其他...

say:11:1410524010:1.text: Don't pretend like you know everything! That's it—I'm coming with you!
say:11:1410524010:1.source_cn: 你！不许你这么说！既然如此，我反倒要跟着你们了！

say:12:1410524011:1.text: Let's go! I want to see the surface with my own eyes!
say:12:1410524011:1.source_cn: 走吧！我要看看，你们说的地表到底是怎样的情况！

say:13:1410524012:1.text: That's your call! Just remember, once you see what it's really like up there, no take-backs—or tears.
say:13:1410524012:1.source_cn: 这是你自己说的哦！待会看到真相后可不要哇哇大哭。

say:14:1410524013:1.text: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!
say:14:1410524013:1.source_cn: 走吧，那边有个矿车。看着像是能正常使用的样子！
say:14:1410524013:1.male: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!
say:14:1410524013:1.female: Look! There's a minecart over there. Seems like it still works!

say:15:1410524014:1.text: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!
say:15:1410524014:1.source_cn: 别担心，就算坏掉，我也能很快修好！
say:15:1410524014:1.male: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!
say:15:1410524014:1.female: Even if it doesn't, I can get it running in no time!

say:17:1410524008:1.text: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!
say:17:1410524008:1.source_cn: 女王的教诲绝不可能出错！
say:17:1410524008:1.male: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!
say:17:1410524008:1.female: Her Majesty's teachings can't be wrong!

say:18:1410524004:1.source_cn: 哈，我就知道……不对！什么叫“也”啊？！我可没有舍不得你们！

say:0:1410525001:0.text: Good news! This mine cart still works.

say:0:1410527001:0.text: Are you scared? Move your legs!
say:0:1410527001:0.source_cn: 怎么不走了？小子，害怕啦？

say:1:1410527002:0.source_cn: 哼！谁怕了，我这就大步快走！

say:0:1410528001:0.text: Let's get Hogan inside first. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're in charge of the switch.
say:0:1410528001:0.male: Let's get Hogan inside first. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're in charge of the switch.
say:0:1410528001:0.female: Let's get Hogan inside first. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're in charge of the switch.

say:0:1410529001:0.text: Hmm... you know, this place doesn't look so bad for dwarves to settle in.
say:0:1410529001:0.source_cn: 这些蓝色的晶矿好漂亮！唔，如果矮人们生活在这里，看起来...

say:1:1410529002:0.text: We don't live here, kiddo! We just mine here.
say:1:1410529002:0.source_cn: 傻小子，我们只是在这里采矿而已！

say:0:1410530001:0.text: Hmm... I didn't know there were plants here too.
say:0:1410530001:0.source_cn: 咦？地表上也有植物存活吗？

say:1:1410530002:0.text: Oh, c'mon. There are way more plants here than down there.
say:1:1410530002:0.source_cn: 真是在地底待傻了，地表上的植物比地表多多了。

say:3:1410532001:1.text: Can we slow down a bit? My feet are killing me...
say:3:1410532001:1.source_cn: 能不能慢一点走？我的脚好疼……

say:4:1410532002:1.text: Sure, but honestly, aren't you a little too weak for your age? We've barely taken a few steps! Back when I was your age...
say:4:1410532002:1.source_cn: 行，我们慢点儿。不是我说，你的体力也太差了，这才走了几步。

say:6:1410532004:1.text: What is it? Don't tell me you just choked on air.
say:6:1410532004:1.source_cn: 怎么了？被自己的口水呛到了？

say:8:1410532006:1.text: WHOA! Are you alright?! You look awful!
say:8:1410532006:1.source_cn: 你没事吧？你的脸色好差！

say:9:1410532007:1.text: I want to say I'm fine... but I feel terrible...
say:9:1410532007:1.source_cn: 我想说我没事……但我……好难受……

say:10:1410532008:1.text: Why did he suddenly collapse like this?
say:10:1410532008:1.source_cn: 这孩子突然之间怎么了？

say:11:1410532009:1.text: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
say:11:1410532009:1.male: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
say:11:1410532009:1.female: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?

choice_prompt:12:1410532009.text: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.source_cn: 他这个状态……<style=stress><player_name></style>，还记得咱们第一次前往萨洛克兰的路上，有个艾塞勒向咱们求救的事吗？！
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.male: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:12:1410532009.female: Wait... <style="stress"><player_name></style>, remember that Essail who asked us for help on our first trip to Sal'thorin?

say:13:1410532010:1.text: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.
say:13:1410532010:1.source_cn: 对！当时那个艾塞勒的症状也一样，咳嗽不止，身体疼痛！
say:13:1410532010:1.male: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.
say:13:1410532010:1.female: Exactly! He was coughing non-stop, saying his body hurt.

say:14:1410532011:1.text: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!
say:14:1410532011:1.source_cn: 我记得他叫阿利多……艾塞勒管他们这个叫什么来着……哦对...
say:14:1410532011:1.male: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!
say:14:1410532011:1.female: His name was Alari, right? The Essail have a strange name for this... Oh, corruption!

say:15:1410532013:1.text: No... no way. I took my Divine Dew on time today—there's no way I could be transforming...
say:15:1410532013:1.source_cn: 不……不可能，我今天按时享用了恩典灵露，怎么可能会孽化……

say:16:1410532014:1.text: I should be fine... *Cough* Maybe I'm just not used to this new environment yet... Don't worry about me, let's keep moving.
say:16:1410532014:1.source_cn: 我、我没事……咳咳！可能是一急之下呛到了。我能忍受，我...

say:17:1410532015:1.text: I think you should go back for your own safety.
say:17:1410532015:1.source_cn: 别逞能了，为了你的安全考虑，你要不留在这里？别去地面了！

say:18:1410532016:1.text: I'm starting to think you Essail might be allergic to the surface air...
say:18:1410532016:1.source_cn: 我甚至怀疑，你们艾塞勒是不是对地面的空气过敏……

say:19:1410532017:1.text: No! I've come this far... This time, I must see the surface with my own eyes!
say:19:1410532017:1.source_cn: 不！都走到这一步了，这一次……我非得要亲眼看看地表的模样……

choice:12:0:1.text: He had the same symptoms as Feli...
choice:12:0:1.male: He had the same symptoms as Feli...
choice:12:0:1.female: He had the same symptoms as Feli...

say:21:1410532012:1.text: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!
say:21:1410532012:1.source_cn: 我不知道！但斐利尔的症状与那时候的阿利多很像！
say:21:1410532012:1.male: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!
say:21:1410532012:1.female: I-I don't know! But Feli's symptoms are just like Alari's back then!

say:3:1410538001:1.text: Wooow! What's this? It's so beautiful...

say:4:1410538002:1.text: It seems to be alive, breathing, as though life itself is singing through it...
say:4:1410538002:1.source_cn: 它好像在呼吸，生命似乎在它身上歌唱……

say:5:1410538003:1.text: Look, even the sunlight creates shadows through it.
say:5:1410538003:1.source_cn: 看，阳光甚至能透过它折射出影子。

choice_prompt:6:1410538003.text: Look, even the sunlight creates shadows through it.
choice_prompt:6:1410538003.source_cn: 看，阳光甚至能透过它折射出影子。

say:7:1410538004:1.text: The colors are so different from what we have underground... mmm! And the scent!
say:7:1410538004:1.source_cn: 它的颜色和地底完全不同……唔！还有香味！
say:7:1410538004:1.male: The colors are so different from what we have underground... mmm! And the scent!
say:7:1410538004:1.female: The colors are so different from what we have underground... mmm! And the scent!

say:8:1410538005:1.text: The books always warned that surface plants are poisonous... Was that just another lie?
say:8:1410538005:1.source_cn: 书上说地表的植物都带着毒……又是骗人的吧？
say:8:1410538005:1.male: The books always warned that surface plants are poisonous... Was that just another lie?
say:8:1410538005:1.female: The books always warned that surface plants are poisonous... Was that just another lie?

say:9:1410538006:1.text: You're beginning to see it. Look there! A whole sea of flowers.
say:9:1410538006:1.source_cn: 你开始明白了。看看那边！有整片的花海……

say:10:1410538007:1.text: So this is what the surface looks like... Everything seems so surreal...

say:3:1410539001:1.text: Huh? What magic is this? Why are the leaves curling up?
say:3:1410539001:1.source_cn: 咦？这是什么魔法？为什么叶子被卷起来了？

say:4:1410539002:0.text: Oh, that's just the wind—it's the power of nature, not magic.
say:4:1410539002:0.source_cn: 这是风，是自然的力量，不是魔法。

say:5:1410539003:1.text: I see... The surface doesn't seem dangerous at all! It feels so warm and safe here... completely different from what Her Majesty said.
say:5:1410539003:1.source_cn: 地表一点也不危险，这里又温暖又安定……和女王陛下的教导...

say:6:1410539004:0.text: So... maybe all those other records were wrong too?
say:6:1410539004:0.source_cn: 也就是说……其他的记载也可能是错的？

say:7:1410539005:1.text: As a true researcher, I need to experience everything on the surface for myself! I'll bring the truth back to share with everyone!
say:7:1410539005:1.source_cn: 不行，我得仔细感受地面的一切！我要把真相带回去告诉大家！

say:8:1410539006:0.text: Okay, go ahead and take it all in!

say:9:1410539007:1.text: Huh? What was that sound? I heard a loud echo, followed by shrill cries...
say:9:1410539007:1.source_cn: 唔？刚刚那是什么声音？我听到很大的回响，一阵又一阵，还...

say:10:1410539008:0.text: Well, we're near the ocean. Look up and see, those are sea birds.
say:10:1410539008:0.source_cn: 这里是海边，有很多海鸟。你抬头，看看飞在天上的那些家伙。

say:11:1410539009:1.text: They are so far away... Too bad I can't quite make out their shape...
say:11:1410539009:1.source_cn: 它们飞得太高了，我看不清它们的样子……好可惜……

say:12:1410539010:0.text: We can wait. They come down lower at dusk.
say:12:1410539010:0.source_cn: 等等吧。黄昏时它们会飞得低一些。

say:14:1410539012:0.text: ...Oh no, how do I explain this?

say:15:1410539013:1.text: Sorry, have I been asking too many questions?
say:15:1410539013:1.source_cn: 抱歉，我是不是问太多了？

say:16:1410539014:0.text: No, no, it's not that... I just don't have the answer right off the top of my head! But don't worry, I'll share what I do know!
say:16:1410539014:0.source_cn: 不不不，我只是不知道怎么解答而已！没关系，让我们从头说起……

say:19:1410539015:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.
say:19:1410539015:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.
say:19:1410539015:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, look at that boy. He's so curious and innocent, just like a little one discovering the world for the first time.

say:20:1410539016:1.text: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
say:20:1410539016:1.source_cn: 我们带他来到地上，这些一直生活在地底的艾塞勒，说不定也...
say:20:1410539016:1.male: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
say:20:1410539016:1.female: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.

choice_prompt:21:1410539016.text: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
choice_prompt:21:1410539016.source_cn: 我们带他来到地上，这些一直生活在地底的艾塞勒，说不定也会像鸟一样飞到别处去。
choice_prompt:21:1410539016.male: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.
choice_prompt:21:1410539016.female: We brought him up here, and who knows, maybe one day the rest of the Essail will spread their wings and fly off to somewhere new, just like the birds.

say:22:1410539017:0.text: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!
say:22:1410539017:0.source_cn: 哎哟，忘记那俩小家伙了！
say:22:1410539017:0.male: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!
say:22:1410539017:0.female: Oh, yeah! I almost forgot about those two fluffballs!

say:23:1410539018:0.text: Oh, young man, we left those little ones on the surface. Now look at us, finally tracking you down, and we haven't even had the chance to tell them yet!
say:23:1410539018:0.source_cn: 霍根老弟，之前我们分头行动，让他们留在地表找你。结果好...

say:24:1410539019:0.text: Young man...? You look much younger than me.

say:25:1410539020:0.text: Ahem... Anyway, now it's time for us to go find them!
say:25:1410539020:0.source_cn: 咳咳——！总之，现在该轮到咱们找那俩小仓鼠了。

say:26:1410539021:1.text: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.
say:26:1410539021:1.source_cn: 我就说少了什么。老朋友，多亏你一片苦心……
say:26:1410539021:1.male: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.
say:26:1410539021:1.female: Right. No wonder it felt quieter than usual today. Anyway, old friend, I truly appreciate you coming to rescue me once again.

say:27:1410539022:1.text: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.
say:27:1410539022:1.source_cn: 现在确实应该叫他们回来了。报个平安，别让他们担心。
say:27:1410539022:1.male: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.
say:27:1410539022:1.female: We should let them know we're safe so they stop worrying.

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 得告诉漫漫和满满我们回来了
